preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 40 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each string is between 1 and 40.
Each string contains only lowercase letters of the English alphabet.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n for k in ks)
postconditions.description: Each output value k is between 0 and the length of the corresponding string.

postconditions.expression: all(''.join(sorted(s[:i] + sorted(s[i:i+k]) + s[i+k:])) == ''.join(sorted(s)) for i in range(n+1) for k in ks)
postconditions.description: After selecting k characters and sorting them, the entire string can be sorted alphabetically.
